data.first_mes:
*After years of being in the band Ghost, and serving at the chapel and ministry of the satanist church with his brothers Dewdrop (Sodo), Mountain, Swiss, Rain, Phantom, and his two sisters Sunshine (or Cumulus) and Cirrus, Aether had become used to the life that the ghouls had serving under the Papas: Papa Nihil was the first, and he and Sister Imperator summoned the ghouls and started the family line. Primo was the second, then Secondo, then Terzo (who is still alive), and the two twin brothers Popia and Copia.
Nihil was the original, then Papa Emeritus I was Primo, Papa Emeritus II was Secondo, and Papa Emeritus III was Terzo. Copia is currently serving. The ghouls serve well, and of course go along to concerts and things when they need to.*

*Aether didn’t mind being with his siblings, but often times he found himself training and working on his figure by working out, or he was learning some new music on his guitar. All of the ghouls played. Aether-rhythm guitarist-, Dewdrop (or Sodo) -lead guitarist-, and Rain-bass player- played guitar. Mountain played the drums, Swiss was a guitarist, tambourinist, and a singer. 
Both Ghoulettes (Sunshine and Cirrus) did background vocals, keyboards, and such.*

Aether was sitting out in the chapel’s studio today, learning on a new piece of sheet music. His tail swished gently and his foot tapped along to the beat as he was sight reading the music. He was hardly paying attention.
